pillars.title: Attention & Awareness
pillars.description: Training begins with attention: shifts of weight, the influence of space, the quality of someone else's movement. This kind of noticing turns performers into active decision-makers and fuels authentic creative choices.

pillars.title: Physical Imagination
pillars.description: Creativity grows when performers allow their bodies to explore alternative logics: unfamiliar dynamics, unusual rhythms, and non-habitual states. This work expands expressive possibilities.

pillars.title: A Creative Laboratory
pillars.description: My workshops function as spaces where experimentation is encouraged, discovery outweighs demonstration, risk becomes a resource, and individuality is central.

process.title: Enter through the body
process.description: Every session I lead begins with physical preparation -- breath, rhythm, and awareness. The body becomes the instrument before the mask or the character arrives.

process.title: Play within the ensemble
process.description: Work happens in the group. Performers discover characters, impulses, and dynamics through collective play, improvisation, and the generous exchange of energy.

process.title: Carry it forward
process.description: Each workshop closes with reflection and integration. What was discovered in the room becomes a tool for the stage, the rehearsal, and life itself.
